paper_title: Search for Axionlike Dark Matter Using Liquid-State Nuclear Magnetic Resonance
notes: CASPEr-Gradient Low-Field NMR haloscope (thermally-polarized methanol proton sample); first dedicated lab search in this mass range. Headline 95% CL limit is the 'Main scan' (green, most sensitive of the three scans) in Fig.3 (figures/ALPlimits.png raster, extracted by green color-matching; Scan A/B are consistency checks). x-axis Frequency nu_a-1348450 Hz over 0-240 Hz => Compton freq nu_a=1.348450-1.348690 MHz => mass m_a=h*nu_a = 5.576741-5.577733 neV. Paper reports native gradient coupling in GeV^-1 (|g_ap| <= 3e-2 GeV^-1) defined via H=g_aNN grad(a).I, I the nuclear spin operator (Zeeman convention H=-hbar*gamma*B.I, so I_z=+/-1/2, I=sigma/2). Applying the 2m_N rule: task canonical H=g grad(a).sigma (Pauli, +/-1) => g_aN=2m_N g; paper's I=sigma/2 => g=g_aNN/2 => g_ap_canonical = m_p*g_aNN_native (m_p=0.9383 GeV). Native ~3e-2 GeV^-1 -> canonical ~2.8e-2 dimensionless. Local DM density rho_DM=0.3 GeV/cm^3 (paper-stated); haloscope limit depends on density, reported as-is without rescaling. Curve roughly flat 2.7-3.1e-2 across the narrow window; proof-of-principle/commissioning measurement.
